events.name: Bash
events.head: Check fix is on origin and live deployment
events.input: $ cd cloud && git merge-base --is-ancestor 51c7ee1 origin/main && echo ON_ORIGIN; npx wrangler deployments list 2>/dev/null | grep -E "Version|Message|Created" | tail -6; grep -n "example" src/util.ts | head -3
